Nairagram Basket

The context.

Business partners need a consistent integration surface and a clear view of the transfers they initiate. Nairagram Basket brings API access, payment workflows, and partner visibility together in a dedicated B2B platform.

My contribution.

  1. Design and improve partner API workflows for initiating payments, checking status, and receiving transaction updates.
  2. Build partner dashboard capabilities for transaction tracking, investigation, and day-to-day integration support.
  3. Support controlled partner access, API authentication, onboarding, and integration troubleshooting.
  4. Connect partner activity with payout orchestration, administrative operations, and reconciliation processes.
  5. Improve error handling, callback processing, and traceability across external partner and internal payment workflows.

The result.

  • A dedicated integration channel for business partners.
  • Better visibility from API submission through payout status and operational follow-up.
A useful partner API is supported by clear state, actionable errors, and a dashboard that helps people solve real cases.
